0.original: Cahciua is ready to head to the fourth and final zone.

25.original: Speak with the Windspath Gardens guard.

48.original: Next, we have to part with...

50.original: Their memories may be gone, but their love will be with me always...

52.original: I must say, the closer we get to the end, the faster time seems to pass us by.

53.original: Come, let's head to the fourth and final zone. By now you know how to get there, yes?

55.original: Excellent. This time, I'd like to quickly check on the Meso Terminal, so I'll meet you at the Gate of Remembrance.

59.original: Like before, it will be hard, but we must honor Cahciua's wish.

61.original: As far as I can tell, we still have some leeway with the Meso Terminal.

62.original: Meaning you can carry on getting to know the Endless in the last zone.

63.original: Windspath Gardens, it's called, and it's breathtakingly beautiful!

64.original: That's where your memories are stored, yes?

65.original: That's right. I left it for last so I could guide you for as long as possible. Very thoughtful of me, yes?

66.original: Ooh! A great idea just occurred to me!

68.original: <chuckle> I'll save it for after we've arrived on the other side. See you there!

69.original: Her “great ideas” are generally less than great.

71.original: As much as I want to grant your mother her wish, I also want to respect yours.

72.original: When all's said and done, I want you to be happy. I hope you know this.

75.original: Cahciua isn't only his mother─she's his mentor as well. That can only make it harder for him to say good-bye.

76.original: Let's go. For now, we keep doing what we've been doing: seeking out Endless and learning what's dear to them.

78.original: I have faith in Erenville's inner strength.

79.original: What could this great idea of Cahciua's be?

81.original: <bleep> <bloop> Error. Error. Verification system...initialized. User registration...confirmed.

82.original: Greetings and welcome to Windspath Gardens, the sanctuary of exploration and discovery! The marvels of the natural world await you!

83.original: Let's help Cahciua make some great memories!

84.original: The sanctuary of exploration and discovery... Quite fitting that Cahciua's memories are here.

85.original: How very like Cahciua to chase her dreams to the last.

87.original: Then with your consent, let's begin our adventure!

88.original: Naturally, while we go about this, feel free to continue befriending Endless. And be sure to absorb the delightful scenery!

89.original: I thought those things were some sort of enormous tree, but they're actually sculptures!

90.original: The scenery here is nothing short of remarkable. To think that Sphene has managed to preserve it for the Endless...

93.original: This particular garden is called Blooms of Discovery. Beautiful, isn't it?

94.original: It's absolutely stunning! And they are all actual plants?

95.original: They are indeed. These specimens were brought here hundreds of years ago for conservation, as the calamity had pushed them to the brink of extinction.

96.original: So this zone is like a great conservatory.

97.original: Precisely, my dear Krile! Here you'll find flora and fauna the likes of which no longer exist elsewhere.

98.original: Doesn't the thought just set your heart aflutter?

100.original: I expect that some creatures I encountered outside of Tural may have cousins in this world.

101.original: While I am no expert on life in the reflections, it would make for an interesting study to compare them.

102.original: Now there's an idea! Leave it to my pupil to think up such.

103.original: Here we have not only a worlds-traversing adventurer and a veteran gleaner, but a pair of Sharlayan's finest scholars besides.

104.original: It's a veritable gathering of inquisitiveness, and I'm thrilled to be part of it!
